thought_path_snapshot: Check for Inversion by keeping the first note of the first melody the same in the second melody and inverting the rest of the notes based on the interval from the first note.

The issue lies in the `is_transposition` function, which incorrectly calculates the difference in semitones between the first notes of the two melodies and then checks if this difference holds for all subsequent notes. This approach fails when the transposition involves wrapping around the octave. Instead, we should calculate the difference for each pair of corresponding notes and ensure they are consistent modulo 12.
